content: According to the newest version of the Remote Work Policy (2026), employees who have completed the probation period may work remotely up to **two days per week**. In the older version (2023), employees were allowed to work remotely up to **three days per week**. Warehouse and dispatch roles are not eligible for remote work, as their work requires physical presence on site [remote_work_policy#0000][remote_work_policy_2023#0000].
